root_idea.summary: The root has two closely related orientations: attaining victory or mastery, and the strength or gripping quality associated with a nail or claw.
root_idea.development: The victory branch denotes gaining or granting success and overcoming. The nail-and-claw branch extends to insertion, attachment, wounding, nail-like emergence, and names for objects resembling a nail or claw.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form IV verb with a distinct causative victory construction.
Quran-attested nominal referring to nails, claws, or talon-like extremities.

senses.definition: To grant victory over, cause to prevail over, or give mastery over.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative transitive construction, used with عَلَى in the Quranic occurrence; the object of the victory is expressed as the defeated party.

senses.definition: A nail, claw, or talon; in the Quranic animal expression, a nail-like or undivided terminal extremity, including claws and comparable solid hoofs.
senses.usage_conditions: In كُلَّ ذِي ظُفُرٍ, the expression is interpreted variously as animals with claws or with undivided toes, including such examples as camels and ostriches. The lexical core is the nail- or claw-like extremity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A weapon, metaphorically likened to a bird’s claw as its means of attack.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on the resemblance between a weapon and a claw.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attain, obtain, acquire, or gain possession of what one seeks; to succeed, win, or overcome.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بِـ, عَلَى, or a direct object; the same verb may denote finding a lost animal or gaining mastery over an enemy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the eye to develop a pterygium or nail-like growth over its surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional medical or descriptive construction concerning the eye.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a she-camel to receive impregnation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form I usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: My eye has not seen you; I have not seen or encountered you for some time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression about not seeing someone recently.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal Himyerite meaning reported in Classical lexicographical material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To insert or fix one’s nail or claw into something; to scratch, wound, mark, or break it; by extension, to cling to or take firm hold of something, or to seize it with talons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person’s nail, an animal’s claw, or a bird of prey’s talons; the related Form VIII expression is given with the same sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For a plant or the land to put forth nail-like shoots or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plant-growth usage, emphasizing emergence in a form resembling nails or talons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perfume a garment with the substance called ظُفْر or أَظْفَار.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive construction concerning perfuming cloth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rub skin so that its creased parts become smooth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use of the Form II verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to attain or obtain what was sought, to make someone successful, or to cause someone to overcome an opponent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative victory or success construction, commonly used with بِـ or عَلَى; it may also be used in declaring someone the victor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pray or wish that someone attain the desired result, succeed, or be victorious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A devotional or optative use of the Form II verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To league together and aid one another against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَلَى or an equivalent construction meaning “against”; related forms with تَضَافَرَ and تَظَاهَرَ are reported as synonyms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A group of small stars in or near Lyra, named for resemblance to talons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative astronomical name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Weak, abject, despicable, or ineffective; in one use, sick or diseased.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic characterization, especially of one unable to harm or overcome others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Through the whole body, from extremity to extremity; used in the expression “to wound him from nail to eyelid.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom for wounding someone extensively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: No one or nothing is present; in related usage, a year of drought left nothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use of ظُفْرٌ and related expressions for complete absence or depletion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: I saw him himself, or him in person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic emphatic expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Names of plants resembling a vulture’s or cat’s claw.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Fixed botanical names derived from the nail-or-claw sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An odoriferous substance resembling a human nail, used in incense or perfumery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized materia-medica term, sometimes treated as plural-only or without an ordinary singular.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Large ticks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The creased or folded parts of a skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative plural use based on the appearance of nail-like creases.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part at either curved end of a bow beyond the place where the string is tied.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote one end or both ends of the bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quality of having long nails.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of a person’s nails.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Low or depressed ground that produces plants or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized landscape term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having sharp nails or claws.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of the nails or claws.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Successful, victorious, or habitually attaining whatever one pursues.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a pterygium or nail-like growth over the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival medical description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A burning or biting plant resembling a nail in its emergence and used beneficially for foul ulcers and warts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical and medicinal term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The rounded head of the prickles of the thistle called حَسَك.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed botanical expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pterygium: a fleshy or membranous growth from the inner side of the eye that can extend over the white toward the pupil and obscure sight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A medical noun with several recorded variant names.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place-name for one or more cities or fortresses in Yemen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proposed additional interpretation connects the name with land possessing means of resisting invaders, but that reading is textually uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An appellation of the Prophet, associated with the success-and-victory adjective family.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical entry records it chiefly as an honorific appellation and relates it to ظَفِرٌ and ظَفِيرٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of or from Dhafar in Yemen; applied to objects such as onyx, aloe wood, or related imported aromatics.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nisbah adjective referring to the Yemeni place-name ظَفَارِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having long or broad nails; also applied to a camel’s nail-like foot extremity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival form describing a person or a camel’s manسم.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The slender tendril that twines around a grapevine branch.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative botanical use based on a nail-like or claw-like form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow whose two ends have been somewhat cut away beyond the points where the string is tied.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive adjective applied to a bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An instrument for grasping or extracting, specifically the tool called مِنْقَاش, tweezers or forceps.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical instrument name derived from the gripping function of a claw.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Overcome or conquered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial expression applied to one defeated by another.

cautions: The public nominal headword is normalized to ظُفْرٌ, while the Quranic surface form is ظُفُرٍ.
Classical interpretations of كُلَّ ذِي ظُفُرٍ differ in whether the expression emphasizes claws, undivided toes, or comparable solid hoofs.
The proposed interpretation of ظَفَارِ as land possessing means of resisting invaders is tentative because the lexical text itself marks the reading as uncertain.
